messages:
susan: Alert - noticed a big traffic skew to us-east-1 starting ~1758203300. Correlated with fallback events from regional routing. dashboard shows steady requests from EU customers hitting us-east.
kevin: :eyes: saw similar on the console metrics. fallback_count spiked and origin_region tag is empty for a lot of requests.
mike: quick summary: new model-variant rollout did a canary that reduced capacity in eu-west. Smart routing fallback tried cross-region failover + model-variant substitution and ended up rerouting many requests to the same dedicated pool in us-east.
julia: sounds like a thundering-herd on fallback. are fallbacks immediate or queued? what's our default fallback_policy right now?
infra-lucy: default is "prefer-region, immediate-fallback-to-compatible-variant" with no per-customer cooldown. that was meant to minimize latency but it can amplify if region gets congested.
product-ryan: this was triggered by the A/B rollout from yesterday (variant-b). We need UX to include expected capacity delta and a rollout safety knob.
kevin: mitigation proposal: toggle fallback to queued with per-customer cooldown and cap concurrent cross-region fallbacks. we can change runtime config with internal API. sample:
```
POST /internal/routing/policies/active
{
  "fallback.mode": "queued",
  "fallback.cooldown_s": 60,
  "fallback.max_cross_region_per_min": 50
}
```
susan: +1. can infra-lucy flip the policy while we investigate model capacity?
infra-lucy: doing it now. /ops run update-routing --policy queued --cooldown 60 --cross-region-cap 50
ops-bot: deploy started for routing-policy update (run id: rp-20260318-011). will post status.
ops-bot: deploy succeeded. new routing policy active in 6 regions.
mike: after the change fallback_count dropped ~80% and cross-region traffic normalized. still seeing a small number of repeated hops (fallback->fallback) from certain tenants.
julia: we should instrument fallback_hop_count and add a circuit-breaker: if hop_count > 2 for same request/session, reject to fallback and return 503 with reason 'routing-loop'.
kevin: agreed. filing infra ticket. also add a short-term heuristic: when fallback target pool saturates, prefer returning 429/503 instead of immediate cross-region fallback.
product-ryan: for rollouts UX: add an estimated fallback-risk metric in the console before enabling variant split. show estimated extra cross-region qps and likely latency delta.
infra-lucy: created ticket INF-8723: add fallback_hop_count, circuit-breaker, and saturation-reject heuristic. will PR today.
susan: also flag for billing/alerts team - this caused a cost spike; add budget alert if cross-region egress > X for a tenant during fallback windows.
kevin: long-term: consider graded fallback strategies by customer tier. enterprise customers get queued failover + warm standby; free-tier gets fast fallback but with stricter caps.
mike: we should also add a console toggle that can temporarily 'disable model-variant substitution' during capacity anomalies. quick toggle would help rollbacks.
product-ryan: noted. I'll sketch UX: 'Fallback behavior' modal on rollout page with presets: conservative / balanced / aggressive.
infra-lucy: PR up at https://git.internal/rw/infra/merge/642
ops-bot: alert cleared at 1758203458. summary: routing-policy changed -> fallback spike reduced -> follow-up tickets created.
kevin: thanks all. owners: infra-lucy for runtime fixes (INF-8723), product-ryan for rollout UX, billing for cost alerts.
susan: follow-up sync at 10:30 to review post-mortem and console changes. :white_check_mark:
